note: Motonari waits under the cherry trees outside the castle for his bride, Lady Myo (Kikkawa), who arrives in a procession. The woman in court robes who speaks first and laughs at the end is taken to be Lady Sugi (she raised Motonari). Japanese transcribed with faster-whisper large-v3 (tools/transcribe_movie.py, clips re-run with tools/transcribe_clip.py) and corrected by context and the frames; times in seconds from the start of the film (frame = round(t * 15) + 1). Speaker names are notes only (not shown).
